data.narrative:
Union is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $51.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies across the defense tech sector—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised ($51M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $128M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector comparables (Stark Defence, UFORCE, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI) yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with the peer range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous company trajectories and application focus within Defense & Security.

The triangulated valuation range is $109M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $564M. The 10x spread between low and high scenarios reflects acute uncertainty around Union's product-market traction, technology differentiation, and addressable market within a capital-efficient, high-variance sector. Stage-progression yields a tighter signal; peer-median is heavily influenced by outlier valuations. Validation of near-term revenue, customer pipeline, and technical defensibility would be critical to narrowing this band.
